_comment: Merged into a repo's .claude/settings.json by turma:bootstrap. Wires the Claude Code hooks: the two optimizer-loop nudges and the read-outside-repo guard. The git post-commit hook (hooks/commit-queue.sh) is installed into .git/hooks/post-commit, not here. Hook scripts are copied into <repo>/.claude/hooks/ so scripts/check.mjs can verify them against the catalog.
